cells.gaps: The National ICT Policy 2007-11 ended in 2011 and no row records a successor sector policy adopted or in preparation. MUS-010 is valued actions, but its fact says the programmes sit in a separate National ICT Strategic Plan that is not held and the policy gives no costs, so no delivery plan is read. The older NTP-2004 (MUS-001 to MUS-006) states no period; the cell is staged on the newest adopted policy and not on a mix. No reporting has been found, the only governance facts are the 2004 policy's, and nothing is dated in the last twelve months.
cells.note: National ICT Policy 2007-11: the newest adopted sector policy, text public, its period ended in 2011 with no successor sector policy on record, so the cell is unplaced and lapsed rather than stage 2 or 3. Digital Mauritius 2030 is held, a noted class that places nothing.
